notes.title: Upcoming Patch: Subtitles, Language Support, and Privacy Updates
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone! [/p][p]We’ll be performing server maintenance on [b]September 22nd from 6:00 PM – 9:00 PM PST[/b] to prepare for our next update. When servers come back online, the [b]new subtitle and language support features[/b] will officially go live.[/p][p][/p][p]Since launch, more than 50,000 of you from all around the world have joined Stella’s journey. We’ve heard a ton of great feedback from our global community, and one theme has come up again and again: [b]language is the bridge for connection and storytelling.[/b] With this update, we want to make it easier than ever for every player to build a deeper, more seamless bond with Stella.[/p][p] [/p][h2]What’s New in This Update[/h2][h2][/h2][h3][b]1. Multilingual Subtitles (Video Calls Only)[/b][/h3][p]
We’ve added subtitles to video call mode in 11 supported languages:
Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Thai, Vietnamese, Indonesian[/p][list][*][p]Note: Text chat remains in English for now.[/p][/*][/list][p]You can enable subtitles in Settings or by hovering over the subtitle icon (bottom-right corner) for two seconds and selecting your language.[/p][p][/p][p][b]You can learn about the feature in this new video: [/b][/p][previewyoutube="nIcrqKZQZ20;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3][b]2. Multilingual Voice + Text Recognition[/b][/h3][p]
Stella can now understand your voice or text input in all of the supported languages above. That means you can speak (or type) to her in your own language, and she’ll understand what you mean:  whether you’re in video call or text chat mode.[/p][p][/p][h3]3. [b]Privacy Policy Updates[/b][/h3][p]As part of our commitment to protecting your privacy, we've taken the community's feedback and used it to clarify and update our privacy policy. This update provides clearer explanations on several key areas of our policy to be accountable to and enhance transparency for our users.[/p][p]  [/p][p]These updates include clarifications on:  [/p][list][*][p]The personal data we collect from you, why and how we use them[/p][/*][*][p]How data is used for model training, together with precise instructions on opting out of this[/p][/*][*][p]User-generated inputs and sensitive personal data[/p][/*][*][p]Information sharing with third parties[/p][/*][*][p]Our use of cookies and similar technologies[/p][/*][*][p]How we secure your data[/p][/*][/list][p]With these features, we hope it’s easier than ever to connect with Stella and enjoy a smoother, more immersive experience. More than anything, we want her to feel like a real companion: someone who can bring a little warmth to your time in this digital world. [/p][p][/p][p]– The Whispers from the Star Team[/p][p][/p][p][b]字幕、多语言支持与隐私政策更新[/b][/p][p] [/p][p]各位玩家朋友，大家好！[/p][p]我们计划在[b]北京时间9月23日上午9时至12时[/b]（对应太平洋时间9月22日下午6时至9时）进行停服更新，为下一次更新做准备。服务器重新上线后，全新的字幕与语言支持功能将正式上线。[/p][p] [/p][p]游戏上线以来，我们的销量已达到50000+份，用户来自全球多个国家，同时，我们也受到了大量来自全球玩家社群的宝贵反馈。我们深知，语言是情感和故事的桥梁，希望新功能的上线可以回应大家的期待，让每一位玩家都能与Stella建立更深层、更少障碍的沟通。[/p][p] [/p][p]随着字幕功能的上线，我们希望有更多的玩家可以和Stella建立更顺畅的交流，得到更优质的游戏体验。或许，我们也期望她能成为一位真正的伙伴，在数字世界中带给玩家一份独特的温暖。[/p][p] [/p][h2][b]本次更新内容[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]1.多语言字幕（仅限视频通话模式）[/b][/h3][p]
为帮助玩家更准确地理解游戏对话，我们在视频通话模式（[b]文字聊天界面暂时仍为英语[/b]）中加入了多语言字幕功能。本次更新支持[b]中文、日语、韩语、法语、德语、西语、葡语、俄语、、越南语和印尼语[/b]，您可以在游戏设置中开启，或鼠标悬停右下角字幕功能图标2秒后，选择相应语言开启。[/p][p][/p][h3][b]2.多语言语音及文本识别[/b]
[/h3][p]同时，Stella将在版本更新后能够识别并理解来自多种不同语言的玩家语音和文字。届时，玩家可以直接使用对应语言与她进行交谈。[/p][p]
*  需要注意的是，当玩家打开多语言理解功能后, Stella回复的速度会比原来额外增加2-4秒的延迟[/p][p][/p][h3][b]3.隐私政策更新[/b]
[/h3][p]更新了我们的隐私政策。本次更新旨在就几个关键领域提供更清晰的解释，以对用户负责并提升透明度。
更新的内容版块包括：[/p][list][*][p]搜集数据的品类、原因和使用。[/p][/*][*][p]数据和模型训练，并提供了明确的关闭该功能的操作指南。[/p][/*][*][p]如何处理玩家生成内容和敏感个人数据。[/p][/*][*][p]数据在何种情境下涉及三方的分享。[/p][/*][*][p]Cookie数据相关使用情境的界定。[/p][/*][*][p]我们如何保护您的数据安全。[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Your reviews = our next trailer!
notes.content: [h2]Your reviews = our next trailer! [/h2][p][/p][p]Since launch, you’ve shared so many hilarious, heartfelt, and bizarre conversations with Stella… and we want to show them off! We’re officially inviting you to share your favorite “Stella Moments.” [/p][p][/p][h3]\[How to Share] [/h3][p]Post your moment in a Steam Review (this ensures our team can see it no matter what language you speak). Your entry can be: [/p][list][*][p]A full conversation with Stella [/p][/*][*][p]A single killer line [/p][/*][*][p]Or just your overall thoughts on the game [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]\[What’s Next?][/h3][p] We’ll be featuring our favorite submissions in an upcoming official trailer and across community highlights. Your words might just become part of Stella’s journey.[/p][list][*][p]Event runs until August 27, 2025 [/p][/*][*][p]Winners will be contacted directly via replies under their Steam review  [/p][/*][*][p]Use the hashtag [url="https://x.com/hashtag/StellaMoments?src=hashtag_click"]#StellaMoments[/url] if you’re sharing on socials, too! [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for every late-night chat and heartfelt story with Stella. We can’t wait to celebrate your moments together.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45694074/73d7fac1cd8cb35f2dcb8c2b8705471ccf6baf92.png"][/img][/p][p]大家好！[/p][p]自《Whispers from the Star》上线以来，我们收到了大家分享的无数与Stella的对话——有的搞笑，有的暖心，还有的...脑洞大开。我们希望能将这些精彩的瞬间展示给更多人！[/p][p][/p][p]现在，我们正式邀请你分享你最爱的“Stella时刻”。[/p][p][/p][h3][b]【如何分享你的时刻？】[/b][/h3][p]在你的Steam评测中，分享你与Stella最有趣的、最感动的、或最让你印象深刻的“神对话”，当然也欢迎分享你对游戏的想法。加上#StellaMoments或#Stella时刻[/p][p][/p][h3][b]【下一步？】[/b][/h3][p]请随时保持关注——我们会回复我们最喜一些分享者，由Stella复现你们的“时刻”，用在我们未来的官方内容进行展示。你的故事，将有机会成为Stella旅程的一部分。[/p][p][/p][h3][b]【对话示例（中英文均可，请确认对话真实性）】[/b][/h3][p]你: "帮我算个数，1+1等于几？"[/p][p]Stella: "根据我的计算，答案是‘田’。我算对了吗？"[/p][p][/p][h3][b]【注意事项】[/b][/h3][list][*][p]📅 本活动截至2025年8月28日[/p][/*][*][p]🏆 被选中的玩家官方将在Steam直接回复[/p][/*][*][p]🔖 如果在社媒分享，也请带上话题#StellaMoments或#Stella时刻[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]***为了能方便地看到来自全球玩家的多语言分享，我们决定将 Steam评测 作为本次活动的主要渠道。[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45694074/a342d8a2454f75bbc46168ab4240891f8f84ddce.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Voice Input Stability & Hardware Compatibility Update
notes.content: [h2]Major Updates[/h2][h3]Microphone Hardware Detection & Voice Input Improvements[/h3][list][*][p][b]Expanded microphone hardware status detection[/b] - Added comprehensive monitoring for various microphone devices[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enhanced microphone status notifications[/b] - Improved feedback system to prevent voice input crashes and anomalies[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Link compatibility improvements[/b] - Added experimental support for Steam Link microphone usage[/p][/*][/list][h3]Important Microphone Setup Requirements:[/h3][p]Please ensure the following for an optimal voice input experience:[/p][olist][*][p][b]Confirm your microphone device is plugged in and enabled[/b] during gameplay[/p][/*][*][p][b]Set your microphone as the default recording device[/b][/p][list][*][p]Right-click the system sound icon → Sounds → Set as default microphone device[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Grant microphone permissions to the desktop application[/b][/p][list][*][p]Refer to the previous patch notes for a detailed permission setup guide[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Avoid using virtual audio input devices[/b] - Use physical microphone hardware only[/p][/*][/olist][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][h3]Text Chat Mode Fixes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Fixed Stella response issues[/b] - Resolved cases where Stella would stop responding in text conversation mode, eliminating the need for application restarts[/p][/*][/list][h3]Stability Improvements[/h3][list][*][p][b]Fixed various minor crash issues[/b] - Addressed several small but impactful stability problems[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Thank you for your continued feedback and support![/b][/p][p][i]If you encounter any issues with this update, please report them through Steam's feedback system or our community forums.[/i][/p]
